name: Tropical Kiss
source:
Kaito left his hometown with a dream to be a big man. But he doesn't have any clear ideas, so he just lazily lives every day. It's no good. Kaito decides to work at a newly opened resort facility called "A LO HA". But he meets various girls he had relationships before there...

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090826124019/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1013437]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
怀揣着出人头地的梦想背井离乡的海人，因为毫无明确人生规划，整日浑浑噩噩、懒散度日。深感不能再这样颓废下去的他，决定到一家新开业的南国度假村“A LO HA”打工重新振作；谁知刚一入职，他便在那里接连重逢了数位昔日曾与自己有过感情纠葛的少女……
